subject: [hw] V41 rev 5 update for review: 639/639; power lock + result-sized sync
body: Update to the rev 5 I asked you to review: acceptance is now 639/639 (600 per config + 39 real n2vcu), not 630. Same public API. Changes: power_lock around the refcount/hw->power (4-thread hammer test, TSan-clean), result-sized from_device sync, and the newest-nonzero cookie fallback in the synchronous encode lookup (wait_done already had it). Header documents that guest_unmap() keeps an entry register() created and guest_forget() releases it. fakevenc/run_session.sh still validates the 115841-byte stream; host/run_vhost.sh the same. STATUS.md updated.
